title: 人力资本发展
summary: 评估公司人才培养、技能发展与职业晋升体系，以及人才储备的可持续性。

sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Human Capital Development Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate's (MSCI S&C's) $^{1}$ outputs are determined. Human Capital Development is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their workforce talent requirements and their ability to attract, retain and develop a highly skilled workforce.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍人力资本发展关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解 MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队（MSCI S&C）$^{1}$ 如何形成评估结果。人力资本发展属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型社会支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖人才需求，以及吸引、保留和培养高技能员工队伍的能力。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“数据、评级与得分”章节。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: \- Inability to attract skilled talent to fill role requirements, loss of competitiveness.
blocks.content_cn: • 无法吸引具备所需技能的人才填补岗位，导致竞争力下降。

blocks.content: \- Loss of intellectual and human capital through attrition, key-person risk.
blocks.content_cn: • 因人员流失损失知识资本和人力资本，并面临关键人员风险。

blocks.content: \- Increased costs associated with high employee turnover (e.g., recruitment, training).
blocks.content_cn: • 因员工流动率高而增加招聘、培训等成本。

blocks.content: \- Low workforce productivity.
blocks.content_cn: • 员工生产率低。

sections.title_cn: 人力资本发展关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Human Capital Development Key Issue score evaluates the company's level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.

blocks.content: This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated.
blocks.content_cn: 该得分来源于按0-10分制评分的指标，10分对应最佳实践。更多细节请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"风险管理分析"部分。除特别注明外，数据来源为公司披露。

sections.title_cn: 人力资本发展战略得分

blocks.content: The Human Capital Development Strategy score evaluates the company's initiatives to build and manage its workforce through talent pipeline strategies, grievance procedures, and employee feedback mechanisms. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 人力资本发展战略得分评估公司通过人才梯队战略、申诉程序和员工反馈机制建设及管理员工队伍的举措。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: - Extent of human resource-related grievance reporting or escalation procedures
sections.title_cn: 人力资源相关申诉报告或升级处理程序的覆盖程度

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has an internal reporting channel or escalation procedures for employees to report human resource-related grievances.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否建立内部报告渠道或升级处理程序，供员工报告人力资源相关申诉。

sections.title_cn: • 员工满意度调查频率。

blocks.content: Definition: The frequency of employee satisfaction surveys. Best practice is at least annually.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：员工满意度调查的频率。最佳实践是至少每年一次。

sections.title_cn: 正式人才梯队发展战略

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether a company has a formal talent pipeline development strategy in place, evidenced through structured recruitment programs (such as graduate traineeships, internships, or apprenticeships) and explicit statements linking talent pipeline development to the company's long-term business or workforce strategy.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否制定正式人才梯队发展战略，证据包括结构化招聘计划，例如毕业生培训、实习或学徒计划，以及明确将人才梯队发展与长期业务或人力战略联系起来的声明。

sections.title_en: Human Capital Development Programs & Initiatives score
sections.title_cn: 人力资本发展项目与举措得分

blocks.content: The Human Capital Development Programs & Initiatives score evaluates the company's initiatives to support employees through benefits, pay structures, equity programs, training, and performance management. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 人力资本发展计划与举措得分评估公司通过福利、薪酬结构、股权计划、培训和绩效管理支持员工的举措。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_cn: • 员工股权计划。

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of eligibility for an employee stock ownership plan and/or an employee stock purchase plan. Best practice is for all permanent employees to have access to such programs to participate.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：员工符合员工持股计划和／或员工购股计划参与条件的覆盖程度。最佳实践是所有正式员工均可参与。

sections.title_cn: • 基于绩效的浮动薪酬组成部分

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether non-officer and non-sales staff are eligible for variable performance-based pay, such as bonuses.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明非高级职员及非销售人员是否有资格获得奖金等基于绩效的浮动薪酬。

sections.title_en: • Workforce eligible for paid parental leave policy
sections.title_cn: • 符合带薪育儿假政策条件的员工范围

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company's workforce is eligible for material non-pay benefits, evaluated through the company's paid parental leave policies, considering both the duration of paid leave and the scope of employee coverage based on publicly available information. The industry-leading practice is when a company's paid parental leave policies cover all employees across its global operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：通过公司的带薪育儿假政策，评估员工获得重要非薪酬福利的资格覆盖程度，并根据公开信息考虑带薪假期时长及员工覆盖范围。行业领先实践是政策覆盖全球运营的所有员工。

sections.title_en: - Regular performance appraisals and feedback processes
sections.title_cn: 定期绩效评估与反馈流程

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether and to what extent the company undertakes programs for employee professional development, such as performance reviews, goal setting and review, or similar. Best practice is for such programs to be provided to all permanent employees.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否开展及在多大程度上开展员工职业发展计划，例如绩效评估、目标设定与回顾等。最佳实践是向所有正式员工提供此类计划。

sections.title_cn: • 技能与知识发展培训

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of managerial/leadership development training. Best practice is a training program in which all employees participate.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：管理及领导力发展培训的覆盖程度。最佳实践是所有员工均参与培训计划。

sections.title_cn: 人力资本发展绩效得分

blocks.content: The Human Capital Development Performance score evaluates the company's performance on human capital development metrics (including employee turnover and recognition as an employer of choice), relative to its peers. It is expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 人力资本发展绩效得分评估公司相关指标相对于同行的表现，包括员工流动率及理想雇主认可。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Employee turnover rate performance relative to peers
sections.title_cn: • 相对于同行的员工流动率表现

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on reported employee turnover rate, and trend in employee turnover rate, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司报告的员工流动率及其变化趋势相对于同行的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: ○ Employee turnover rate industry relative score
sections.title_cn: ○ 员工流动率行业相对得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on employee turnover rate relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司员工流动率相对于同行的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_cn: ■ 三年平均员工流动率

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company's three-year average employee turnover rate.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司员工流动率的三年平均值。

sections.title_en: ○ Employee turnover rate industry relative trend score
sections.title_cn: ○ 员工流动率趋势行业相对得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on the three-year average of year-over-year trend in employee turnover rate, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司员工流动率同比变化趋势的三年平均值相对于同行的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: ■ Three-year average employee turnover rate trend
sections.title_cn: ■ 员工流动率趋势的三年平均值

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company's three-year average of year-over-year employee turnover rate trend.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司员工流动率同比变化趋势的三年平均值。

sections.title_en: • External recognition as employer of choice (last three years)
sections.title_cn: • 过去三年获选理想雇主的外部认可

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company received external recognition as an employer of choice in the last three years.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否在过去三年获得理想雇主的外部认可。

sections.title_cn: 争议事件

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management score based on the severity, status, and the company's role in the controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment.
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在此关键议题上所涉争议的严重程度、状态及公司角色，从总体管理得分中扣减 0—5 分。评估采用以下争议类别。

blocks.content: • Labor management controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 劳工管理争议事件。

blocks.content: • Collective bargaining controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 集体谈判争议。

blocks.content: • Discrimination and workforce diversity controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 歧视与员工多样性争议。

blocks.content: For more details on how controversies are included in the MSCI ESG Ratings model, refer to the Controversies cases section of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 关于争议如何纳入 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“争议案例”章节。

sections.title_cn: 人力资本发展风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Human Capital Development Exposure score evaluates the company's exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Company-Specific Exposure scores. The Business Exposure score is scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. The Company-Specific Exposure score functions as an addition to the Business Exposure score, with an additive impact of 0 to 2 points. Refer to the Analyzing risk exposure section of "ESG Ratings Methodology" for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure score calculation:

sections.title_cn: 业务敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Exposure score is a weighted average of the Business Segment Exposure scores of a company's business segments. scores are weighted by the proportion of a company's total assets in each business segment, $^{2}$ using the following formula to calculate the Business Exposure score:

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $BSE_{HCD,j}$ is the Business Segment Exposure score for business segment $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BSE_{HCD,j}$ 为业务分部 $j$ 的业务分部风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $w_{Asset,i,j}$ is the weight of business segment j for company i based on the contribution to total company assets.
blocks.content_cn: • $w_{Asset,i,j}$ 为公司 i 的业务分部 j 按其占公司总资产比例确定的权重。

blocks.content: \- $n_{i}$ is the number of business segments of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $n_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的业务分部数量。

sections.title_cn: 业务板块敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure score is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. Each business activity score is determined by a simple average of the Annual Salary score and the Higher Education Workforce score.
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部风险敞口得分。各业务活动得分由年度薪酬得分与高等教育员工得分的简单平均值确定。

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $AS_{j}$ is the Annual Salary score for business activity $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $AS_{j}$ 为业务活动 $j$ 的年度薪酬得分。

blocks.content: \- $HEW_{j}$ is the Higher Education Workforce score for business activity $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $HEW_{j}$ 为业务活动 $j$ 的高等教育员工得分。

blocks.content: The Annual Salary score and Higher Education Workforce score are based on a calculation that compares the relative ranking of a business activity on specific metrics (annual salaries and educational attainment of employees, respectively) to all other business activities on those same metrics. The Annual Salary score of a business activity is based on the $75^{\text{th}}$ percentile of the annual salaries for each business activity. The Higher Education Workforce score is calculated based on the proportion of employees with Bachelor's Degree or higher for each business activity.
blocks.content_cn: 年度薪酬得分与高等教育员工得分，分别比较一项业务活动在年度薪酬及员工受教育程度指标上，相对于所有其他业务活动的排名。年度薪酬得分以各业务活动年度薪酬的第 $75^{\text{th}}$ 百分位数为基础；高等教育员工得分按各业务活动中具有学士及以上学位的员工比例计算。

sections.title_cn: 公司特定敞口得分

blocks.content: The Company-Specific Exposure score is an addition to the Business Exposure score, with an additive impact of 0 to 2 points.
blocks.content_cn: 公司特定风险敞口得分叠加至业务风险敞口得分，增加 0—2 分。

blocks.content: The following formula is used to compute the Company-Specific Exposure score:
blocks.content_cn: 公司特定风险敞口得分按以下公式计算：

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $ILO_{HCD,i}$ is the Incidence of Layoffs score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $ILO_{HCD,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的裁员发生情况得分。

blocks.content: \- $IMA_{HCD,i}$ is the Incidence of Major Mergers and Acquisitions score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $IMA_{HCD,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的重大并购发生情况得分。

blocks.content: The Incidence of Layoffs score is assessed as 1 if layoffs in the last three years affect more than 10% of the workforce or more than 1,000 employees per company; otherwise, it is assessed as 0. The Incidence of Major Mergers and Acquisitions score is assessed as 1 if major Mergers and Acquisitions activity in the last three years affects more than 10% of the workforce or more than 1,000 employees per company; otherwise, it is assessed as 0.
blocks.content_cn: 若过去三年裁员影响超过公司员工总数的 10% 或超过 1,000 名员工，裁员发生情况得分为 1，否则为 0。若过去三年重大并购活动影响超过公司员工总数的 10% 或超过 1,000 名员工，重大并购发生情况得分为 1，否则为 0。
